WITH eligible_free_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        "School Name",
        "Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)",
        "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)",
        "Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS Eligible_Free_Rate
    FROM 
        frpm
    WHERE 
        "District Type" = 'Continuation' AND 
        "School Type" = 'Public' AND 
        "Educational Option Type" = 'Regular'
)
SELECT 
    "School Name",
    "Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)",
    "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)",
    Eligible_Free_Rate
FROM 
    eligible_free_rates
ORDER BY 
    Eligible_Free_Rate ASC
LIMIT 3
